title: Moving Money with Purpose: Hear from the Team Powering Our Mission
summary: See how Remitly's team is building the fastest, most reliable way for customers to move money around the world.
body_markdown:
For millions of people around the world, sending money across borders is about much more than a transaction. It can mean supporting a loved one through a medical emergency, helping build a business or career, or simply making everyday life a little easier.


That responsibility has shaped Remitly from the beginning.


As the pace of technological innovation, development, and execution continues to accelerate, o


ur team continues to obsess over building the most fair, fast, and flawless way to move money.


Our ability to successfully launch new products and improve upon our existing offerings has never been greater, aided by leaner teams and AI. Our team


understands every transaction matters to a real person, and that’s why the entire Remitly team cares deeply about our customer-focused mission.


[Watch the video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wMnK3KfRBzE) to hear directly from the Remitly team about the company, our customers and what’s ahead.
